title: The Worm Era
summary: SQL injection and worms dominate. Botnets emerge as criminal infrastructure. MySpace XSS worm infects 1M accounts in 20 hours.
paradigm_shift: Cybercrime transitions from vandalism to profit-driven operations.
lesson: Patch management and input validation are foundational — not optional.

title: Phishing Goes Mainstream
summary: Phishing attacks surge 250%. Storm Worm creates massive botnet. TJX breach exposes 94M credit cards.
paradigm_shift: Financial fraud becomes primary cybercrime motivation.
lesson: Email security and user awareness training are critical defenses.

title: Data Theft Industrialized
summary: Organized crime adopts cybercrime at scale. Monster.com breach. Hannaford Brothers payment card theft.
paradigm_shift: Personal data becomes a commodity traded on dark web markets.
lesson: Data classification and encryption at rest are essential.

title: Nation-States Enter the Arena
summary: Conficker infects 9M+ machines. Georgia cyberattacks coincide with military conflict. First clear nation-state cyber operations.
paradigm_shift: Cyber operations become a component of geopolitical conflict.
lesson: Critical infrastructure requires nation-state level threat modeling.

title: APT Campaigns Emerge
summary: Operation Aurora targets Google and 30+ companies. Ghostnet espionage network discovered. APT becomes a recognized threat category.
paradigm_shift: Long-term persistent access replaces smash-and-grab attacks.
lesson: Threat hunting and behavioral detection are needed against APTs.

title: Stuxnet Changes Everything
summary: Stuxnet — the first cyberweapon — sabotages Iranian nuclear centrifuges. ICS/SCADA security becomes a national security issue.
paradigm_shift: Cyber weapons can cause physical destruction. ICS security becomes critical.
lesson: Air-gapping and supply chain security are essential for critical infrastructure.

title: Hacktivism Peaks
summary: Anonymous and LulzSec dominate headlines. RSA SecurID breach compromises 2FA for millions. Sony PSN breach exposes 77M accounts.
paradigm_shift: Hacktivism demonstrates that ideology, not just profit, drives attacks.
lesson: Certificate authority security and 2FA infrastructure require extra protection.

title: Destructive Malware
summary: Shamoon wipes 30,000 Saudi Aramco workstations. Flame espionage malware discovered. LinkedIn breach exposes 117M passwords.
paradigm_shift: Destructive malware used as geopolitical weapon against energy sector.
lesson: Offline backups and business continuity planning are critical for energy sector.

title: The Snowden Year
summary: Snowden revelations expose mass surveillance. Target breach via HVAC vendor. Adobe breach exposes 153M accounts. Mega-breach era begins.
key_events: Target breach (110M records via HVAC vendor)
paradigm_shift: Third-party vendor access becomes a primary attack vector.
lesson: Third-party vendor access must be strictly controlled and monitored.

title: Year of the Mega Breach
summary: Heartbleed exposes half the internet. Sony Pictures destroyed by North Korea. Home Depot, eBay, JP Morgan all breached. 1B+ records stolen.
paradigm_shift: Open source vulnerabilities can affect billions of systems simultaneously.
lesson: Open source dependency security and rapid patch deployment are critical.

title: Healthcare Under Siege
summary: Anthem breach exposes 78M health records. OPM breach steals security clearance data of 21M federal employees. Healthcare becomes top target.
paradigm_shift: Healthcare data becomes more valuable than credit cards on dark web.
lesson: Healthcare organizations must treat patient data with financial-sector security standards.

title: Ransomware Explosion Begins
summary: Mirai botnet takes down internet via IoT. Bangladesh Bank heist steals $81M via SWIFT. US election interference. Ransomware revenue surges.
paradigm_shift: IoT devices become weapons. Ransomware becomes a billion-dollar criminal industry.
lesson: IoT security standards and SWIFT security controls are urgently needed.

title: WannaCry & NotPetya Devastate the World
summary: WannaCry hits 150 countries. NotPetya causes $10B in damage. Equifax exposes 147M Americans. Shadow Brokers leak NSA tools.
paradigm_shift: Nation-state cyberweapons leak and are repurposed by criminals at massive scale.
lesson: Patch management is a national security issue. Cyberweapon proliferation is a global risk.
defensive_focus: Emergency patching, network segmentation, offline backups

title: State-Sponsored Attacks Normalize
summary: Marriott breach (500M records) undetected for 4 years. SamSam ransomware hits Atlanta. Facebook Cambridge Analytica scandal. GDPR enacted.
paradigm_shift: Long-dwell-time breaches show detection is as important as prevention.
lesson: Mean time to detect (MTTD) must be measured and minimized. GDPR raises accountability.

title: Ransomware Targets Government
summary: BlueKeep threatens Windows RDP. Capital One breach via SSRF. Ransomware hits 22 Texas municipalities simultaneously. RDP becomes primary vector.
key_events: Capital One breach (106M records via SSRF)
paradigm_shift: Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) enables low-skill attackers to deploy sophisticated ransomware.
lesson: RaaS democratizes ransomware. Government entities need dedicated cybersecurity resources.

title: COVID-19 Accelerates Cyber Threats
summary: SolarWinds supply chain attack compromises US government. COVID-19 drives remote work explosion. Zerologon critical flaw. Ransomware doubles.
paradigm_shift: Supply chain attacks can compromise thousands of organizations simultaneously. Remote work expands attack surface.
lesson: Zero-trust architecture is essential. Supply chain integrity verification is critical.
defensive_focus: Zero trust, supply chain security, remote access security

title: The Year of Critical Infrastructure Attacks
summary: Log4Shell affects billions of devices. Colonial Pipeline shuts down US fuel supply. Kaseya hits 1,500 businesses. ProxyLogon hits 250K Exchange servers.
paradigm_shift: Critical infrastructure is now a primary ransomware target. Single vulnerabilities can affect billions of devices.
lesson: Critical infrastructure requires mandatory cybersecurity standards. Dependency management is a national security issue.
defensive_focus: Critical infrastructure security, dependency management, MFA

title: Ukraine War Spills into Cyberspace
summary: Russia-Ukraine cyber conflict. Lapsus$ teen hackers breach Okta, Microsoft, Nvidia. LastPass developer laptop compromise. Uber MFA fatigue attack.
paradigm_shift: MFA fatigue attacks bypass 2FA. Developer workstations become high-value targets.
lesson: Phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2) is needed. Developer security hygiene is critical.
defensive_focus: FIDO2 MFA, developer security, secrets management

title: MOVEit and the Scale of Supply Chain
summary: MOVEit zero-day hits 2,700+ organizations (62M records). MGM Resorts vishing attack. AI-generated phishing surges. Cl0p ransomware dominates.
paradigm_shift: AI enables phishing at unprecedented scale and quality. File transfer software is a critical attack surface.
lesson: AI-powered attacks require AI-powered defenses. File transfer tools need rigorous security assessment.
defensive_focus: AI security tools, file transfer security, vishing defenses

title: AI-Powered Attacks and Healthcare Crisis
summary: Change Healthcare breach disrupts US healthcare for months (100M records). XZ Utils backdoor shows 2-year supply chain patience. Snowflake mass breach via infostealers.
paradigm_shift: AI-assisted attacks, infostealer malware, and patient supply chain attacks reach new sophistication levels.
lesson: Healthcare is critical infrastructure. Infostealer malware is the new credential theft vector. Open source maintainer security needs funding.
defensive_focus: Healthcare security mandates, infostealer detection, open source security funding

title: The AI Security Inflection Point
summary: AI-generated malware, deepfake social engineering, and autonomous attack tools emerge. Quantum computing threatens current encryption standards.
paradigm_shift: AI fundamentally changes the attacker/defender balance. Post-quantum cryptography migration becomes urgent.
lesson: Organizations must adopt AI-powered defenses, begin PQC migration, and treat AI security as a board-level issue.
defensive_focus: AI security, PQC migration, autonomous defense systems
